question: If cot A = {12 over5}, then the value of sin A = ?
solution:
Given:

cot A = {12 over5}

Formula used:

(Hypotenuse)² = (Perpendicular)² + (Height)²

Calculations:

⇒ cot A ={Baseover Perpendicular}= {12 over5}

⇒ Length of the perpendicular = 5

⇒ Lenth of the base = 12

Using the above formula,

⇒ (Hypotenuse)2 = (Perpendicular)2 + (Height)²

⇒ (Hypotenuse)2 = 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169

⇒ Hypotenuse = sqrt{169} = 13

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4a45d64b3973c140f84cd8ede09b0d0de5843aabf8a1578aa22128ccf37370d.png] 

⇒ Sin A = (Perpendicular)/(Hypotenuse )={5over13}

**⇒ Hence, Value of sin A is 5/13**
